completion:
Identify areas where losses are recorded.
3. Adjust the financial categories where the losses are recorded to minimize their visibility. For example, classify operating expenses as investments or R&D costs.
4. Make sure the balance sheet and income statement still present a picture that generally aligns with the company’s actual financial activities.
5. Alter the timing of revenue recognition to make more revenue appear in the period under review.
6. Recognize revenue prematurely, before the earnings process is complete.
7. Delay the recognition of expenses to present a better picture of profitability.
